scope: Targeted static source review of project/work-package/table/principal-reference/status/progress/parent/relation/version/workflow/sprint/board domain; native MCP and HTTP work-package create/search/update/comment/relation interfaces and Enterprise/config gate; parser/lock-version contracts, service pipeline, transaction/advisory context, assignment/move permissions, ancestor/related updates, type/status and type-only relation validation boundaries, system duplicate closure and deletion; selected backlog single/batch placement locks/revalidation/rollback and sprint finish; journal SQL creation/aggregation, events/GoodJob notification workflow/completion timestamp/recipient visibility, selected outgoing webhook paths; authentication registration/API token hashing/expiry; representative frontend form/payload/detail and deployment/dependency configuration. Selected contract/request/threaded concurrency assertion bodies read. Relevant task/model/service/tool inventories searched for attempt/lease/heartbeat/capacity/agent-owner alternatives. No candidate application/install/build/migration/test executed. Not every-line, all plugins/automations/importers/exports/editions/custom fields/graph races/file/mail-push/OAuth-OIDC/dependency internals/performance/browser/accessibility/deployment/production concurrency certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Common create contract/set attributes, new default work-package model, SQL save and dependent ancestor/rescheduling/watcher work in user transaction. Native MCP create non-idempotent; structured API/MCP source records, no execution acquisition or retry result key claimed.
lifecycle_review.select: Visible project/assignee/status/type/version/label/subject API/MCP snapshots; MCP paginated at declared size40. Parent/recursive relatability checks and blocker-aware closed-status filtering exist, but no execution ready reservation. Type-only canonical relation update does not trigger endpoint-changed cycle predicate; compound type/status follows destination-type available states rather than normal predecessor gate.
lifecycle_review.claim: Model-class/id transaction-scoped advisory locking and optimistic lockVersion reject stale edits; parse missing version=>nil. Assignee/responsible principal validation and field/move permissions, no mandatory unowned/worker-eligible/capacity/current-attempt/lease predicate. A fresh user edit remains possible after assignment changes.
lifecycle_review.progress: Durable notes/descriptions/custom fields/context, SQL journals and effort/progress hierarchy derivations. Status-based percentages and weighted/simple ancestor aggregation are planning metrics, not accepted results. Frontend carries lockVersion and schema writable values; local update event can precede persistence.
lifecycle_review.review: Role/type/author-assignee workflow transitions, readonly states, blockers and custom field validation provide controlled edits. No reviewed immutable result-revision/attempt reviewer acceptance or verified-child join. Type-change and system EmptyContract duplicate paths are exceptions to normal transition policy.
lifecycle_review.complete: Closed status classifies work; ancestor progress is not parent accepted-child completion. Before-save duplicate closure updates others as User.system with EmptyContract, cause and logged failure. Sprint finish moves unfinished work and marks iteration complete; distinct from all tasks accepted.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Contracted deletion plans descendant detach/destroy, reschedules successors/ancestors, removes notifications and reloads stale descendants for retry. Transactions preserve planning changes, no external agent process abort, side-effect reversal, execution credential revocation or native runtime resume.
lifecycle_review.recover: Shared PostgreSQL/user authority across hosts with model mutex and selected backlog placement/lifecycle locks/cohort reloads. No work-owner heartbeat/lease/current-attempt recovery in inspected task protocol. Journals coalesce compatible same-actor updates; dated completion jobs reject superseded snapshot timestamps. GoodJob external workers preserve jobs but unhandled-error automatic retry disabled; selected webhook timeout retry. Notification queries retain recipient/current-resource permission. Event-to-job/dependency adapter durability and HA not certified.
